title: fritillaria lusitanica var. neglecta
intro: Fritillaria lusitanica var. neglecta, commonly known as a type of lilyturf or a variety of the Lusitanian fritillaria, is a plant species native to China. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including bronchitis, cough, and fever, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function. The therapeutic actions of Fritillaria lusitanica var. neglecta include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, saponins, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
